summary: Completed public API and browser E2E testing for authentication, activities, focus recovery, reflection, navigation, profile theme, and mobile layout.
action_items: Consider calculating streak current-day comparisons in the user's configured timezone rather than server UTC.
Add brute-force lockout coverage/implementation if required by the auth playbook.
critical_code_review_comments: stats_for converts session dates to the user's timezone but compares the newest day against datetime.now().date() in server UTC, which can misreport current streak and today's sessions around midnight.
The implementation has no failed-login counter or lockout despite the requested auth playbook check for lockout after five failures.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users and activities through public registration; one completed test session was created for each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL tested. Auth, starter ownership baseline, Google credential-gated response, activity creation, active session pause/refresh recovery, completion reflection, Explore/Journey/Insights/Profile navigation, theme save, mobile nav and horizontal overflow all passed. Password reset email delivery and Google OAuth remain MOCKED/deferred by design.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced. Review-only risks: server-UTC comparison in stats_for can disagree with timezone-normalized session dates; no lockout state exists after repeated invalid passwords.
